title: Gluing pullback of direct images on an arbitrary open union
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], U and V arbitrary opens and M any O_X-module sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For each open A let J_A = j_A,* (M restricted to A), with the fixed nested-open restriction maps from def-pc-kinjective-mayer-vietoris-data. The square with upper left J_(U union V), upper right J_U, lower left J_V and lower right J_(U intersection V), and all four arrows the fixed restrictions, is a pullback in O_X-module sheaves. No injectivity, covering assumption on X or complex is required.

proof.text: Apply the sectionwise amalgamation theorem at every test open.
Use the assembly theorem to obtain the categorical pullback.

lean.statement:
theorem schemeOpenUnionModuleImage_isPullback
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U V : X.Opens)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) :
    IsPullback
      ((schemeOpenModuleImageRestriction X
        (homOfLE (le_sup_left : U ≤ U ⊔ V))).app M)
      ((schemeOpenModuleImageRestriction X
        (homOfLE (le_sup_right : V ≤ U ⊔ V))).app M)
      ((schemeOpenModuleImageRestriction X
        (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ≤ U))).app M)
      ((schemeOpenModuleImageRestriction X
        (homOfLE (inf_le_right : U ⊓ V ≤ V))).app M)
